about: E2A Voice Dynamics curve, Arrow Press 1-3-1 V2: dB offset per line vs the explanation (B) level. A hook, B explanation, C activation, D defensive reads, E conclusion.
lines: This is the one-three-one arrow press.
The point turns the ball to the sideline.
The sideline and the half-court line are two extra defenders.
The middle takes away the middle.
The far wing reads the cross-court pass.
The safety guards the long pass.
and the arrow becomes a one-three-one zone.
